title: Primero, luego, al final: telling events in order

sections.content: You know the markers *primero*, *luego*, *después* and *al final* from A2 Unit 11. They put the events of a story in order. The peace process in Central America happened step by step, country by country, so these markers keep the sequence clear.

items.spanish: Primero, los presidentes firmaron el acuerdo de Esquipulas II en 1987.
items.english: First, the presidents signed the Esquipulas II agreement in 1987.

items.spanish: Luego, Violeta Chamorro ganó las elecciones de Nicaragua en 1990.
items.english: Then Violeta Chamorro won the elections in Nicaragua in 1990.

items.spanish: Después, el gobierno de El Salvador y el FMLN firmaron la paz en 1992.
items.english: After that, the government of El Salvador and the FMLN signed peace in 1992.

items.spanish: Al final, Guatemala firmó la paz el 29 de diciembre de 1996.
items.english: In the end, Guatemala signed peace on 29 December 1996.

sections.content: *Primero* opens the sequence, *luego* and *después* continue it, and *al final* closes it. Put a comma after the marker. Dates make the order checkable, so give them.
